objective: Enforce the configurable IMAGES cache budget across Desktop GIF files in the current hashed cache and the legacy gif-cache directory while preserving offline hits.

implementation.sharedCache: The current media-cache-v1/images/gifs files and legacy cacheDir/gif-cache files now share the GIF allocation from the IMAGES category.
implementation.legacyKey: Recognized old entries use the SHA-256 digest of the source URL followed by .gif.
implementation.eviction: Recognized regular files across both directories use one LRU byte/file budget. New writes check the current dynamic quota before storing data.
implementation.migration: A valid legacy GIF is copied into the hashed cache, size-verified, and removed from the old directory only after successful migration.
implementation.readOnlyBehavior: When storage policy disallows new writes, an existing valid legacy GIF is returned for offline use without creating a hashed copy.
implementation.readPerformance: Read-triggered directory cleanup is rate-limited to once per 15 seconds per cache instance; writes still perform a complete budget check.
scopeLimits: This is Desktop-only; no Android APK was changed or built.
No physical PC interaction or sustained performance measurement was performed.
The MSI is a local validation artifact and was not published.
